name: Country
definition: 具有明确地理边界与主权管辖范围的政治实体，是联赛等体育组织活动的所属地域单元 Counterexample: 与'地区/城市'混淆：后者是主权国家内部的次级行政单元，不具备主权属性 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table Country; provenance: direct source Country

name: League
definition: 由特定地域范围内若干球队按既定赛制长期进行的周期性竞技赛事组织 Counterexample: 与'杯赛'混淆：后者为淘汰制短期赛事，而联赛为循环积分制的长期赛事 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table League; provenance: direct source League

name: Match
definition: 在特定日期于特定赛事中由两支球队按规则进行的单场竞技对抗事件，以进球数决定结果 Counterexample: 与'赛季'混淆：后者是包含多场比赛的时间周期，而非单次对抗事件 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table Match; provenance: direct source Match

name: Player
definition: 以个人身份注册并参加竞技比赛的职业运动员，具有姓名、出生日期、身高体重等自然属性 Counterexample: 与'球队'混淆：后者是由多名球员组成的集体组织，而非自然人 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table Player; provenance: direct source Player

name: Player_Attributes
definition: 在特定日期对某名运动员竞技能力各项指标进行量化评估后形成的信息记录 Counterexample: 与'球员'混淆：后者是自然人实体，前者是对该人某时点能力的评估数据记录 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table Player_Attributes; provenance: direct source Player_Attributes

name: Team
definition: 由多名运动员组成、以集体身份参加竞技赛事的体育组织，具有全称与简称 Counterexample: 与'球员'混淆：后者是自然人个体，前者是由多人组成的组织实体 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table Team; provenance: direct source Team

name: Team_Attributes
definition: 在特定日期对某支球队战术风格各项指标进行量化评估后形成的信息记录 Counterexample: 与'球队'混淆：后者是组织实体，前者是对该组织某时点战术特征的评估数据记录 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table Team_Attributes; provenance: direct source Team_Attributes

name: BuildUpPlaySpeed
definition: Team attribute measuring the speed of build-up play.

name: BuildUpPlayPassing
definition: Team attribute measuring the passing style during build-up play.

name: ChanceCreationPassingClass
definition: Categorical class describing the safety of passing when creating chances.
aliases: played safe while creating chance of passing

name: TeamLongName
definition: Full official name of a team.

name: TeamShortName
definition: Abbreviated name of a team.

name: TeamFifaApiId
definition: FIFA API identifier for a team.

name: LeagueName
definition: Name of a football league.

name: Season
definition: Season identifier for matches.

name: HomeTeamGoals
definition: Number of goals scored by the home team in a match.

name: AwayTeamGoals
definition: Number of goals scored by the away team in a match.

name: AwayTeamApiId
definition: API identifier for the away team in a match.

name: PlayerName
definition: Full name of a football player.

name: Birthday
definition: Date of birth of a player.

name: Height
definition: Height of a player in centimeters.

name: OverallRating
definition: FIFA overall rating of a player.

name: AttackingWorkRate
definition: Player's tendency to attack.
aliases: tend to be attacking when their mates were doing attack move

name: DefensiveWorkRate
definition: Player's tendency to defend.
aliases: remain in his position and defense while the team attacked

name: Volleys
definition: Player attribute for volley ability.

name: Dribbling
definition: Player attribute for dribbling ability.

name: Finishing
definition: Player attribute for finishing ability.

name: PlayerAttributesDate
definition: Date of the player attributes record.

name: TotalGoals
definition: Sum of home and away goals in matches. Formula: HomeTeamGoals + AwayTeamGoals. Inputs: HomeTeamGoals = Match.home_team_goal; AwayTeamGoals = Match.away_team_goal

name: AverageOverallRating
definition: Mean overall rating of a player over time. Formula: AVG(OverallRating). Inputs: OverallRating = Player_Attributes.overall_rating

name: RatingPercentageDifference
definition: Percentage difference between two players' overall ratings. Formula: (OverallRating_player1 - OverallRating_player2) / OverallRating_player2 * 100. Inputs: OverallRating = Player_Attributes.overall_rating

name: AverageBuildUpPlayPassing
definition: Average build-up play passing across teams. Formula: AVG(BuildUpPlayPassing). Inputs: BuildUpPlayPassing = Team_Attributes.buildUpPlayPassing

name: AverageFinishing
definition: Average finishing attribute of players. Formula: AVG(Finishing). Inputs: Finishing = Player_Attributes.finishing

name: MaxHeight
definition: Maximum height among players. Formula: MAX(Height). Inputs: Height = Player.height

name: MinHeight
definition: Minimum height among players. Formula: MIN(Height). Inputs: Height = Player.height

name: CountPlayers
definition: Count of players matching criteria. Formula: COUNT(PlayerName). Inputs: PlayerName = Player.player_name

name: CountMatches
definition: Count of matches per league or season. Formula: COUNT(Match.id). Inputs: Season = Match.season; LeagueName = League.name

name: CountWins
definition: Count of wins for a team. Formula: COUNT(CASE WHEN HomeTeamGoals > AwayTeamGoals THEN 1 END) + COUNT(CASE WHEN AwayTeamGoals > HomeTeamGoals THEN 1 END). Inputs: HomeTeamGoals = Match.home_team_goal; AwayTeamGoals = Match.away_team_goal

name: TeamPlayingStyle
definition: Analyze team attributes related to playing style such as build-up speed, passing, and chance creation.

name: PlayerWorkRate
definition: Analyze player work rates for attacking and defensive tendencies.

name: PlayerSkills
definition: Analyze player skill attributes such as volleys, dribbling, and finishing.
